استوئين (form X)
# اُسْتُوئِينَ (ustūʔīna) /us.tuː.ʔiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# اِسْتَوْئِينَ (istawʔīna) /is.taw.ʔiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
